name: DeKalb County School District Work-Based Learning
org: DeKalb County School District, Career, Technical and Agricultural Education
what_you_do: Take a school class that places you in a paid or unpaid job or internship related to your career goal while you finish high school. Juniors and seniors start this work experience.
who_can_apply: DeKalb County School District students, mostly juniors and seniors. The program page links to a PDF of the rules on grades, behavior and attendance. Ask your school's WBL coordinator for the current rules.
pay_detail: Paid or unpaid work experience. Pay amounts are not stated.
duration: A school class block (1, 2 or 3 periods in a row)
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Ask your school's Work-Based Learning coordinator.
how_to_apply: Apply to your school's WBL coordinator. Ask what the current rules are.
notes: Only for DeKalb schools students. You must leave campus at the start of your first WBL class, even on days you are not scheduled to work. The district CTAE office is at 1701 Mountain Industrial Blvd, Stone Mountain, GA 30083.
